headline: Google DeepMind uses AI to formally verify parts of Signal's encryption
summary: Google DeepMind combined human researchers and AI agents to formally verify that Signal's encryption, including its post-quantum handshake and Triple Ratchet, works as intended, in a four-week project. DeepMind hopes to extend the approach to other systems and plans to open-source its AlphaProof Code.

claims.statement: Google DeepMind used AI to formally or mathematically verify that Signal's encryption protocol works as intended.
